nodes.name: Claude — Classify Lead
nodes.notes: Claude classifies lead as hot/warm/cold and drafts all response messages

nodes.notes: Parses Claude's JSON and merges with original lead data

nodes.notes: Immediately sends WhatsApp confirmation to the customer

nodes.name: WhatsApp — Alert Owner
nodes.notes: Sends lead summary WhatsApp alert to the business owner

nodes.notes: Adds the lead to the CRM Google Sheets tab

meta.description: Webhook receives new leads from any source (website form, FB ad, chatbot). Claude classifies as hot/warm/cold. Immediately sends WhatsApp confirmation to customer and alert to owner. Adds lead to CRM Google Sheet. Hot leads also receive an immediate personalised email within 2 minutes.
